taxonomy_note: Initial root-cause lens; reassess final mapping.

controls.boundary: OAuth/OIDC and account linking — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map authorization server, client, redirect URI, session correlation, code exchange, identity claims and account-linking decision. Record provider/library versions and public versus confidential client behavior.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two controlled identities and browser sessions to trace one complete login or link ceremony. Check whether the callback is bound to the initiating session, expected provider/client and intended account. For linking, compare the authenticated account receiving the link with the external subject actually proven by the exchange.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A callback URL, client ID or provider login page is not a secret. Do not declare login CSRF or account takeover from a missing parameter name when the actual library provides equivalent supported binding.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use the provider-supported flow and bind transaction, client, redirect and stable subject to the intended account. Retest legitimate login/linking, wrong-session/provider callback and the originally evidenced mismatch.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
